statement: Given finitely many nonempty symmetric open intervals with centers in [a,b], strictly ordered centers, pairwise noncontainment, and a cover of [a,b], the left and right endpoints are strictly ordered; consecutive intervals overlap; and strictly increasing cuts exist in the proper intersections between consecutive centers.
assumptions: Ioo(c_i-r_i,c_i+r_i) is not a subset of Ioo(c_j-r_j,c_j+r_j) for every distinct ordered pair i,j
every x in [a,b] belongs to at least one retained open interval
novelty_boundary: Formalizes the elementary finite-cover and cut construction used in the source proof; makes no independent mathematical novelty claim.
costs: Finite classical choice and real linear arithmetic only; no asymptotic computation.
falsifier: A countermodel satisfying the stated hypotheses but lacking ordered cuts; the checked proof rules this out in Lean's kernel.
next_gate: Compose with local-family construction and prove that global eventual activity places the limiting minimum-coordinate inside its assigned cut slab.

statement: For local label families tagged by interval index j, replacing each local bump c_{j,k}(h) by c_{j,k}(h)-Σ_{l<j} h^(q_l) preserves LittleO at h^a whenever c_{j,k}=o(h^α), a<α, and each preceding q_l>a. Weak activity of a fixed tag in the combined family implies weak activity within that local family because the shift is common to every label of the tag.
assumptions: finite nonempty local families indexed by Fin N
real power LittleO interface at positive h→0
local bump is LittleO at exponent α>a
every preceding cut exponent q_l is strictly greater than a
novelty_boundary: An internal formalization component, not a standalone theorem of scientific novelty.
costs: Finite sigma-family construction and standard filter algebra; arbitrary opaque tolerance values are only read at fixed slopes by the supplied local guarantee.
falsifier: A Lean kernel counterexample to the exact shift-cancellation or finite LittleO closure statement.
next_gate: Wire the concrete slice-family bump bounds into the exact exponent α=c_j+r_j and the ordered cuts.

statement: If a fixed global tagged label is eventually weakly active, the limiting point is in the cube, its minimum-coordinate s lies in the tag's assigned closed cut slab, and the local family has the stated neighborhood activity guarantee, then every coordinate of the limit differs from that label's slope by less than the fixed tolerance attached to that slope.
assumptions: the local neighborhood guarantee holds for every minimum-coordinate strictly inside its open interval
q cuts lie strictly inside each adjacent pair of open intervals
the first interval extends left of a and the last extends right of b
the same index (j,k) is fixed along the eventually active sequence
global activity is a weak comparison against every tagged label
novelty_boundary: This is the exact inheritance step; the separate global-active-to-slab comparison and the full approximation theorem remain unproved in this file.
costs: No regularity or computation of E is used; only the fixed label's supplied scalar tolerance is used by the local guarantee.
falsifier: A countermodel to slab containment or common-shift activity cancellation under these hypotheses.
next_gate: Prove the missing active-comparison slab theorem using varying-exponent ratios and the local base labels, then compose with compact-neighborhood and slice-family outputs.
